instruments.notes: Purchased put (strike $17) and sold call (strike $20) on oil production, eighteen month period beginning March 1, 1995; monthly settlement, strikes based on average exchange crude price; premium amortized over the period. End month not stated in text.
instruments.evidence_quote:
In 1995, the Company purchased a put option and sold a call option covering
3,300 barrels per day of oil production for an eighteen month period beginning
March 1, 1995.

instruments.notes: Put option purchased for second half of 1994 to guarantee a minimum sales price on crude oil production; strike and volume not stated; not exercised because market prices were higher than strike.

The Company has a limited program of hedging its crude oil inventories and fixed
